assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Create one opaque landscape atlas of six different first-grade science illustrations. Exactly 2 equal rows and 3 equal columns of square cells in a 3:2 image, six occupied cells. Each scene stays entirely inside its own cell with at least 9% quiet margin on each side. Cell boundaries are invisible, no line or art crossing any border. Use a warm ivory matte gouache paper background, simple recognizable silhouettes, fine paper grain, natural colors, apricot and pine accents. For mini stories inside cells, two softly separated subpanels are intentional. Clear shape separation and very simple backgrounds so each cell is readable after reduction to 96 pixels. No text, letters, numbers, logos, checkmarks, arrows or watermark.
Row 1, column 1. Two horizontal subpanels within this one square. Upper: the same small pale-yellow duckling paddles left in still teal water, with a short clear wake behind. Lower: the same silver-gray tabby kitten with dark stripes and a white chest walks left, one front paw lifted in forward stride. Both fully visible.
Row 1, column 2. Exactly the same two stacked subpanels, pale-yellow duckling and silver-gray tabby kitten with white chest. Upper: duckling bends and pecks feed from a low shallow dish, both feet on dry ground. Lower: kitten bends its muzzle toward a simple food bowl, paws planted. Both are eating.
Row 1, column 3. Exactly the same two stacked subpanels and animals. Upper: the SAME swimming pale-yellow duckling with short wake as upper left cell. Lower: the SAME silver-gray tabby kitten with white chest lies calmly resting on the ground with paws tucked, no bowl. Only the duckling is moving.
Row 2, column 1. Two side-by-side subpanels within the square. The same mature brown hornless female cow with cream heart-shaped forehead patch and small cream near-shoulder patch appears once per subpanel, same adult size. Left cow walks left with one forehoof lifted; right cow lowers its head to nibble a small tuft of grass. No calf.
Row 2, column 2. Two side-by-side subpanels within the square. LEFT: one mature brown hornless female cow with cream heart-shaped forehead patch and small cream near-shoulder patch, standing left-facing. RIGHT: the same adult cow, same size and markings, plus one clearly separate smaller brown calf standing just beside it, with white chest and solid brown forehead. Exactly one calf only in right subpanel.
Row 2, column 3. Two side-by-side subpanels within the square. LEFT: one small brown hornless calf with the same cream heart-shaped forehead patch AND cream near-shoulder patch as the adult cow. RIGHT: that same individual has grown into the larger brown hornless cow with the exact same two markings. One animal per subpanel, same left-facing stance.
